title: rig_config v1
description: Declared physical/optical layout of one rig (rigs/<rig_id>/rig.yml): projection paths and camera mounts. Camera fields are expectations that producers' readbacks (Orange camera_geometry_v1) are checked against, not applied state; camera-to-arena assignment is Citrus registered geometry and is not here. Every physical field is a declared value or the string 'unknown'. derived.* fields are products computed by rigconfig.py and checked by tests; rules in rigs/README.md. Host inventory (NIC, IP, lens, sensor) is not here; cameras join to the host config by serial_number.

rig_geometry_revision.description: Bumped whenever any physical field changes, including unknown -> declared. rigs/<rig_id>/revisions.json pins the physical digest of each revision.

last_physical_change.description: Date the hardware was last physically changed (not the date of the declaration).

projection_paths.description: Keyed by a path id (e.g. main). A host binds each path to one display output.

cameras.description: Keyed by camera serial_number as a string, the only join key to host inventory.

projection_mode.description: Physical geometry relative to the reference view (dish seen from above): front = projector light reaches the image surface from above; rear = from below, image seen through the surface. Not the projector menu setting. Rear = -1.

projector_mount.description: Physical body orientation (upright vs inverted). A rotation: parity +1.

projector_firmware_flip.description: Net mirroring set in the projector menu (README maps BenQ Projector Position to this). horizontal/vertical = -1; both (= 180 rotation) = +1.

optical_mirror_count.description: Fold mirrors between projector lens and image surface. Odd = -1.

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).

canvas_space_parity.description: projection_mode x projector_firmware_flip x (-1)^optical_mirror_count: citrus.display_canvas_px (as scanned out, xrandr output unreflected) relative to the canvas as it lands on the dish seen from above. Excludes Citrus's OpenGL presentation reflection and the session's xrandr reflection; Citrus composes those.

viewing_side.description: Expected side of the dish the optical path leaves toward the camera (before any fold mirror). ventral = -1.

optical_mirror_count.description: Fold mirrors between dish and camera. Odd = -1.

reverse_x.description: Expected camera ReverseX, the value Orange's sealed readback is checked against. true = -1; false and not_supported_by_firmware (the camera has no ReverseX node, so it cannot flip) = +1.

reverse_y.description: Expected camera ReverseY, the value Orange's sealed readback is checked against. true = -1; false and not_supported_by_firmware (the camera has no ReverseY node, so it cannot flip) = +1.

rotation_deg.description: Expected software rotation before recording, checked against Orange's readback. A rotation: parity +1.

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).

recorded_space_parity.description: viewing_side x (-1)^optical_mirror_count x reverse_x x reverse_y: camera.recorded_px relative to the dish seen from above.

expected_camera_to_canvas_handedness.description: Keyed by projection path id: preserved when recorded_space_parity x that path's canvas_space_parity = +1, reflected when -1. Per path rather than per arena: which canvas region a camera sees is Citrus's registered geometry. Assumes an unreflected xrandr output.

nominal_geometry.description: Optional. Nominal mount geometry for the deferred parallax model; consumed by no runtime today. Physical: a change bumps rig_geometry_revision. Scale stays in Citrus calibration.

height_above_gel_mm.description: Nominal distance from the lens entrance pupil to the gel surface along the optical axis.

optical_axis_tilt_from_nadir_deg.description: Nominal angle between the optical axis and the vertical (0 = looking straight down/up).
